caseName: Federal Trade Commission v. Raladam Co.
caseNameFull: Federal Trade Commission v. Raladam Co.
attorneys: Solicitor General Thacher, Assistant to the Attorney General. O’Brian and Messrs. Claude R. Branch, Charles H. Weston, William G. Davis, Robert E. Healy, and Martin A. Morrison for petitioner. Mr. Thomas G. Long for respondent.

opinions.text: The petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Sixth Circuit is granted, limited to the question of the jurisdiction of the Federal Trade Commission.
